limitations: SYNTHETIC: invented prices, liquidity, publication times and corporate actions for deterministic software tests only. Not actual SPY/QQQ/IWM/TLT history; regimes and correlations are engineered and cannot demonstrate strategy alpha or validate investment performance. Back-adjustments include future actions.
Raw OHLC are executable-price inputs; adjusted_close is research-only, not guaranteed point-in-time and must never be used for execution.
Historical universe membership, delistings and survivorship are not supplied; missing observations cannot distinguish listing changes, halts or vendor gaps.

Corporate-action coverage is unverified unless independently reconciled. Only splits and USD cash dividends are modeled; no mergers, spinoffs, rights, taxes, payment dates or fractional cash-in-lieu valuations.
available_at and known_at are provider assertions, not independently verified publication timestamps. Data are daily USD bars, not live tradable quotes.

XNYS regular sessions only, 1990-2035, from installed exchange_calendars; future schedules are projections and may change with exceptional closures. Extended hours, instrument-specific halts and venue differences are not represented.
Research screen only; no claim of statistical edge or future profitability.
Synthetic prices never count as investment evidence.
Historical universe, survivorship/delistings and point-in-time adjusted-data limits are not repaired here.
Evaluator is supplied externally: availability gating and realistic execution require independent auditing.
Warmup may carry positions; returns rebase at its last EOD equity and exclude its commissions.
Annualization assumes consecutive daily trading observations; missing source sessions cannot be inferred.
Commission fee_ratio excludes separately unreported spread/slippage components.
Bootstrap is small-sample descriptive, not multiple-search adjusted; prior/external searches are unknown.
Holdout is single-use within this invocation only; caller must persist registration and enforce cross-run sealing.
